newsitem.title: CHINA: China economic growth seen 10.5 percent in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China economic growth seen 10.5 percent in 1997.

text.p: China's economy is forecast to grow by 10.5 percent in 1997 compared with a provisional 9.7 percent in 1996, officials of the State Statistical Bureau said on Monday.
The officials forecast retail price inflation to remain virtually unchanged from the 1996 level of about 6.0 percent.
China uses retail price inflation as its benchmark price figure. Retail price inflation has fallen from 14.8 percent in 1995 and from a communist-era high of 21.4 percent in 1994.
